newsitem.title: TUNISIA: Tunis bourse closes slightly down in thin trade.
newsitem.headline: Tunis bourse closes slightly down in thin trade.

text.p: The Tunis Stock Exchange index on Tuesday closed slightly down by 0.02 percent in lower trade, bourse sources said.
The 31-share index closed at 514.83 from 514.95 on Monday.
Total volume was 646,670 dinars against 21.48 million dinars. Over-the-counter exchanges amounted to 39,295 dinars from 20.7 million dinars on Monday.
Banque de Tunisie won 1.48 dinar to 77.5 dinars.
Leasing firm Tunisie Leasing gained 0.2 dinar to 33.5. Investment fund SPDIT-SICAF rose 0.18 dinar to 20.88 dinars.
UIB bank was up 0.16 dinar to 14.45 dinars.
BIAT bank fell 0.9 dinar to 38 dinars. Banque de l'Habitat was down 0.6 dinar to 19.14.
Household firm Ateliers Mecaniques du Sahel slid 0.25 dinar to 13.5 dinars. Coke and beer bottler SFBT declined 0.14 dinar to 95. BTEI bank was down 0.12 dinar to 23.52 dinars.
